name: Gaga & Design
short: A design house focused on hand-made seating, produced one piece at a time with an emphasis on quality and longevity, and a precise simplicity that plays material, colour and visual weight against one another.
long:
Gaga & Design is a design house focused on hand-made seating, produced one piece at a time. Its philosophy rests on the belief that good design should accompany its owner for many years, functionally and aesthetically.

The visual language leans on precise simplicity alongside a play of material, colour and visual weight, seeking the balance between a beautiful object and a useful piece of furniture. Airy yet present, the collections suit both indoor and outdoor spaces, and are developed in collaboration with designers including Yaacov Kaufman and Neil Nenner.
